method: Compared all four hash-matched candidate graphics with the original PowerPoint-rendered slides. Numeric labels were read from the full slide where chart text is larger than in the transparent crop.

objects.evidenceText: The 2014 tutorial's Japan fixed-broadband-subscriber chart, attributed on the slide to Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, ends at December 2013 with labeled values in millions: Total 35.8, FTTH 25.0, CATV 6.1 and DSL 4.7. The chart depicts FTTH rising and DSL falling over the displayed period beginning March 2008.
objects.reason: Legend, unit, date endpoints and four right-end labels are legible on the original slide. These are historical chart readings, not current subscription counts.

objects.evidenceText: The 2014 tutorial's Japanese optical-wiring demand survey bar chart labels five response percentages: Process time reduction 9.3%, Smaller Bend Radius 12.0%, Easier connection 14.7%, Lower parts cost 14.7%, and No special skill requirement 49.3%.
objects.reason: The five bars and category labels are legible on the original slide. The slide lists respondent types but does not establish a sample size or a current market survey.
A small coin-stack icon decorates the low end of the relative-cost arrow; the comparative cabling labels and arrow are native slide content, and the icon adds no measurable value.
Larger coin-stack clip art decorates the high end of the relative-cost arrow; it carries no numeric cost or independent technical assertion.
